name: facebookresearch_meshrcnn/tools/AGENT.python.tools.md

facebookresearch_meshrcnn/tools/preproce.preprocess_shapenet_dataset: run the ShapeNet dataset preprocessing pipeline to extract meshes, voxels, and sampled points from OBJ files
facebookresearch_meshrcnn/tools/preproce.handle_model_extraction: process a single ShapeNet model to save metadata, mesh data, voxel coordinates, and renderings to disk
facebookresearch_meshrcnn/tools/preproce.align_bbox_coords: align source voxel coordinates to the target mesh bounding box by applying per-axis scale and shift
facebookresearch_meshrcnn/tools/preproce.voxelize_projected_coords: project 3D voxel coordinates through a camera matrix and bin them into a VxVxV voxel grid
facebookresearch_meshrcnn/tools/preproce.load_extrinsics_from_rendering: parse R2N2 rendering metadata to compute extrinsic camera matrices from azimuth, elevation, and distance

facebookresearch_meshrcnn/tools/train_ne.run_trainer_training: run the MeshRCNN Trainer to train a 3D object detection model on Pix3D dataset
facebookresearch_meshrcnn/tools/train_ne.test_trainer_evaluation: test the MeshRCNN model on the Pix3D dataset and return evaluation metrics
facebookresearch_meshrcnn/tools/train_ne.build_train_loader: build a training data loader with MeshRCNNMapper for the configured training datasets
facebookresearch_meshrcnn/tools/train_ne.build_test_loader: build a test data loader with MeshRCNNMapper for the configured test dataset
facebookresearch_meshrcnn/tools/train_ne.setup_configuration: setup the MeshRCNN configuration from a config file and command line arguments

facebookresearch_meshrcnn/tools/train_ne.run_training_loop: run the training loop for ShapeNet mesh reconstruction model with configurable epochs and loss functions
facebookresearch_meshrcnn/tools/train_ne.evaluate_test_set: evaluate a trained mesh reconstruction model on the ShapeNet test dataset using checkpoint weights
facebookresearch_meshrcnn/tools/train_ne.build_data_loaders: build train, validation, and test data loaders for the MeshVox ShapeNet dataset splits
facebookresearch_meshrcnn/tools/train_ne.setup_config_and_logger: setup configuration from YAML file and initialize distributed logging for multi-GPU training
facebookresearch_meshrcnn/tools/train_ne.copy_and_unpack_data: copy and unpack a tar or zip ShapeNet dataset archive to a temporary directory
